title: Archive index lookup
summary: Recover the 0x598d50 archive path traversal and final record selection.
test_description: Compare the original and recovered thiscall routines using the accepted component helper for nested, missing, empty, repeated and trailing separator paths, duplicate names, case sensitivity and packed record indices; verify fixture bytes and FS head remain unchanged.
known_limits: The component lookup is an external dependency of the recovered routine; the test binds it to the accepted original helper.
The original copies the path into an unchecked 512-byte stack buffer; overlong paths, invalid pointers and malformed or cyclic archive data are outside the tested contract.
The record and remaining archive field meanings are not established beyond their observed layouts.
